description: 黑后弃子引入，黑车透视将死
explanation_en: Black sacrifices the queen with check to force White's rook away from e5. The rook on e7 then delivers mate through the opened e-file.

intro.popup: 💡 透视攻击：黑后在b4，黑车在e7，白车在e5和e1。黑方如何弃后完成透视将死？
intro.popup_en: 💡 X-ray attack: Black's queen is on b4 and rook on e7; White has rooks on e5 and e1. How can Black sacrifice the queen to set up an X-ray checkmate?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Qxe1+引入——白车被迫离开e5去吃后，黑车e7透视穿越e5直取e1将死！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qxe1+ forces White's rook away from e5 to capture the queen. The rook on e7 then attacks through e5 and mates on e1.

moves.popup: 黑后弃子Qxe1+！后沿对角线吃白车将军，强制白车e5离开，为黑车的透视攻击清路。
moves.popup_en: Black sacrifices the queen with Qxe1+, capturing the rook with check and forcing White's rook off e5, clearing the line for Black's rook.

moves.popup: 白车被迫吃后，从e5移至e1，e列通道被打开！
moves.popup_en: White's rook is forced to capture the queen, moving from e5 to e1 and opening the e-file.

moves.popup: 透视攻击将死！黑车e7早已透视白车e5盯住e1，白车移走后黑车直取e1将死白王！
moves.popup_en: X-ray checkmate! Black's rook on e7 was already targeting e1 through the rook on e5. Once that rook moves, Rxe1# mates the white king.
